case: Three established answers, each reviewed established: question 1's review names no discriminator and no locator or derivation (recorded best_candidate); question 2's names a discriminator and a locator the hub finds at its offset; question 3's first review names a locator one byte off (recorded best_candidate), and the same seat's later review names it at its offset.
design: docs/adr/0015 'A source-first review': an established attest of an answer that claims established, on a material question, with no discriminator, or a locator that does not verify against the sealed bytes, or neither a verified locator nor a derivation, is recorded best_candidate with the reasons in capped, and the reply says how to fix it; a seat's later review that meets it is its review.
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run, under every stop policy': a best candidate is no disposition (B2); done finishes a run only when every question has one.
docs/adr/0015 'After the run s9722fa': an answer that claims established, every review of which holds it a best candidate, is held so, by readiness as by the done.
